title: Sri Subodharama Raja Maha Vihara
displaytitle: Sri Subodharama Raja Maha Vihara

titles.display: Sri Subodharama Raja Maha Vihara

extract: Sri Subodharama Raja Maha Vihara is a historic Buddhist temple situated at Dehiwala in the Western province, Sri Lanka. The temple is located at the Dehiwala junction on the Colombo-Galle main road, about 9 miles south of Colombo city. The temple has been formally recognised by the Government as an archaeological site in Sri Lanka. The designation was declared on 23 February 2007 under the government Gazette number 1486.
